verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Maritime is a cloud platform with a documented REST API, so an interactive API explorer is a fair thing to ask for. The evidence shows only a static API docs page ('RESTful API for managing agents programmatically', Bearer-token auth), and nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, which suggests no spec-driven 'try it' console exists.
